notes.title: Thanks for getting Antecrypt!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44240245/ad8a3ae51a4e68d75ac39c2c29d50a3abfe4c7c6.png[/img]

[b]Hi everyone![/b]

First of all thank you so much for getting and playing Antecrypt! Antecrypt was our very first game we made as Punkcake Délicieux, we had no idea what we were doing, espeically regarding its marketing, and so the game got very few players on its original release. So it's nice to give it a second chance here!!

As you may already know, we're the team behind 2022 [i]sensation[/i] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972440/Shotgun_King_The_Final_Checkmate/][b]Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate[/b][/url]. But we also made a lot of other games, in fact we made one game a month for most of 2021 and 2022, and we're planning to do it again for the entirety of 2024! You may think this would lead to poor quality games, but we like to think we're actually pretty good at what we're doing here!

Antecrypt was our first game and yet it still remains one of our favorites over two years later! The update with the new original soundtrack is the icing on the cake as far as we're concerned!

If you too are really enjoying the game, [b]there a couple of ways you can help us spread the word:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Write a short review for the game![/b] It can be as short as one sentence, what matters the most is that it exists! This really helps the game gain visibility on Steam!
[*][b]Tell your favorite streamer to play Antecrypt![/b]
[*][b]Tell your friends and post about the game on social media![/b] Here's an example of what you could post or message your friends, feel free to copy and paste:[/list][quote]Woah my favorite french indie game developpers PUNKCAKE Délicieux just released a new game on Steam and it is so! good!!!?! 😍😍💖🤯⚡ It's called "Antecrypt" and you NEED to check it out NOW![/quote]
[i]Just suggestions of course, to be completely honest we'll take the short review over the rest, but you do you, we don't want to force your hand or make things seem insincere![/i]

[b]Anyway, we really hope you enjoy the game![/b]

[b]Please also look forward to the rest of our backlog, one Steam release every Thursday! Next is [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2316900/Metavaxx/]Metavaxx[/url][/b], a Minesweeper X 2D-shooter where you develop a world-saving vaccine!

Have a lovely week! Take care![/b]

[i]-PUNKCAKE Délicieux[/i] 🥞
